_comment: User-editable budget knobs. Dungeon economics (energyCost, maxRoom, maxRunsPerDay) come from config/discovered.json (generated, gitignored) — this file only holds the numbers a human chooses. Session-08: conservative first-session budget, 3 runs at 20 energy each per session-08 brief §5. Session-09: raised to 120/5 per session-09 brief's explicit stated budget ('120 energy this session... covers five runs with margin') for Task 6's five-run stage — the guard-persistence fix landed this session made maxRunsPerSession a REAL cap across process invocations for the first time, and it was still holding at the session-08 conservative value, capping the session at 3 runs before the five-run gate could be attempted.
